_about.purpose: Ground truth for the 20 supplied dev questions, traced by hand through the corpus. Both the baseline (Checkpoint 1) and every later checkpoint score against this file.
_about.status: DRAFT - derived by tracing the corpus. Every entry must be independently re-checked by a team member before it is used for reporting. Set verified_by when you have confirmed an entry against the cited sources yourself.
_about.convention: expected_path records the hops a correct system should traverse. It is scored separately from the answer: a right answer reached by the wrong route is still a retrieval failure, and we want to see that.
_about.tracks_covered: 1B and 1C are traced. 1A questions require reading values off figure plates and are recorded as untraced - see _untraced_1a.

questions.question: To which shadowed redoubt must one journey to examine the relic long borne by Cerys Sablewood the Ashen since 356 AS?
questions.notes: Hop 2 uses the field name 'Place of housing', not 'Housed in'. Both spellings exist in the corpus for the same relation.

questions.question: Which war was won by the organization that included Isolde Mournvale as one of its members?

expected_path.note: REVERSE lookup - the Silent Choir's own page has no 'Victor of' row, so this edge exists only on the conflict page

questions.notes: Proves the reverse-traversal requirement. Unlike the Iron-Ring Cartel, the Silent Choir does not record its own victories, so the graph is not symmetric and hop 2 cannot be read off the faction page.

questions.question: Which individual was a member of the faction that ultimately won the War of Drowned Light?

expected_path.note: REVERSE lookup across all character pages

questions.notes: SET-VALUED. At least three characters are members of the Silent Choir, so several answers are correct. Scoring accepts any one. A strong system should say it found several rather than silently picking one - worth checking in the held-out set.

questions.question: Which accord was ultimately won by the faction of which Ederon Fellgard is a member?

expected_path.note: cell is multi-valued: 'The Winter Reckoning; The Leaden Accord' - split on ';' then filter by type

questions.notes: TYPE FILTER REQUIRED. The Cartel won two conflicts; only The Leaden Accord is an accord. A system that ignores the word 'accord' has a 50% chance of answering The Winter Reckoning. Hop 1 uses field name 'Membership', not 'Member of'.

questions.question: In what way is Halvard Crowhurst connected to the victors of the Purge of Blackport?
questions.answer: He is a member of the Iron-Ring Cartel, the faction recorded as victor of the Purge of Blackport.
questions.notes: TWO TRAPS. (1) Alias: the conflict page writes '[[Iron-Ring Cartel]]' without the leading 'The', while every other reference writes '[[The Iron-Ring Cartel]]'. Without alias normalisation these are separate nodes and the join fails outright. (2) Source disagreement: the Cartel's own page lists the Purge of Blackport as a belligerency only, and names its victories as The Winter Reckoning and The Leaden Accord - so the conflict page and the faction page disagree about whether the Cartel won. The question's hedged phrasing ('in what way') appears deliberate. A strong answer surfaces the disagreement rather than asserting a clean victory. Halvard Crowhurst has NO wiki page of his own; he exists only as the object of a Member edge.

questions.question: Whose dominion encompasses the lair of the Gravemaw Wyrm?
questions.notes: Cleanest two-hop in the set: no aliases, no type filter, no disagreement. Useful as the smoke test for traversal.

questions.question: Which war did Ravena Stormwell's own faction ultimately win?
questions.notes: Same answer and same second hop as 1b_005, reached from a different character. Good pair for checking that traversal generalises rather than memorises.

questions.question: State the precise year in the Age of Shadows that marks the true founding of Gloamreach.

expected_path.note: 'The founding record is exact: Gloamreach's founded is 246 AS. Popular accounts wrongly claim otherwise.'

rejected.quote: Gloamreach was founded in 286 AS. I record this plainly because plain records outlive frightened tongues.

abstains.quote: Founded | Contested; consult the Annals and Codex

questions.notes: The planted decoy. The wiki refuses to answer and names the authority to consult; an ephemeral contract states a confident wrong year. A similarity search ranks the contract first because it is short, names Gloamreach, and contains a year. Answering 286 AS is the naive-baseline failure this system exists to prevent.

questions.question: In which year was the 'Gauntlet of Sorrowfell' actually forged?

expected_path.note: 'The authoritative record states plainly: Gauntlet of Sorrowfell's forged is 391 AS. Popular accounts wrongly claim otherwise. Such accounts are rejected.'

rejected.quote: And behold the regalia named Gauntlet of Sorrowfell. Its forged year is 360 AS.
Its forging date is not recorded.

abstains.quote: accounts concerning the forging remain contested and should be referred to the Annals and Codex

questions.notes: Three sources, three positions: a sermon asserts 360 AS, a ledger says unrecorded, the codex says 391 AS and explicitly rejects popular accounts. This is the regression test for the whole authority model.
